claims.text: The model outperforms previous neural tensor network models by more than 2% in macro-average F1-score for implicit discourse relations.
The model achieves a macro-average F1-score improvement of over 7% compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
The ensemble model achieves a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for implicit discourse relations compared to the previous best.
